descriptionHtml:
AMD Ryzen 5 3400G 4-Core 8-Thread Desktop Processor with Radeon RX Vega 11 Graphics


Build an incredible budget-friendly gaming system or a highly responsive home office PC with the AMD Ryzen 5 3400G desktop processor. Built on the reliable Socket AM4 architecture, this versatile 4-core, 8-thread APU delivers a rock-solid balance of processing power and graphical capability without requiring an expensive dedicated graphics card. It features a 3.7 GHz base clock and up to 4.2 GHz max boost clock, ensuring smooth multitasking, fast application loading, and dependable everyday computing performance.


The absolute highlight of the Ryzen 5 3400G is its powerful integrated Radeon RX Vega 11 graphics, which provides high-quality, smooth esports gaming at 1080p resolutions for popular titles. Operating efficiently with a 65W TDP, this processor supports dual-channel DDR4 memory configurations and comes bundled with the quiet and reliable AMD Wraith Spire cooler in the box. Upgrade your setup with the Ryzen 3400G for an exceptional, all-in-one high-value computing experience.



**AMD Ryzen™ 5 3400G**


**Brand:** AMD

**Model:** Ryzen 5 3400G

**Generation:** 2nd Gen (Zen+)

**Code Name:** Picasso


---


**Core Architecture:**

Total Cores: 4

Total Threads: 8


---


**Clock Speeds:**

Max Boost Clock: Up to 4.2 GHz

Base Clock: 3.7 GHz


---


**Cache:**

Total L3 Cache: 4 MB

L2 Cache: 2 MB (512 KB per core)


---


**Integrated Graphics:**

Graphics Model: Radeon™ RX Vega 11 Graphics

Graphics Cores: 11 compute units (704 shaders)

Graphics Clock: 1400 MHz

Graphics Features: DirectX 12, OpenGL 4.6, Vulkan, H.265/HEVC decode/encode


---


**Memory Support:**

Max Memory Size: 64 GB

Memory Types: DDR4-2933 (officially supported)

Memory Channels: 2 (Dual Channel)

ECC Memory Support: Yes (with supported motherboard, but not officially validated)


---


**PCI Express:**

PCI Express Revision: 3.0

Max PCI Express Lanes: 12 (8 for GPU + 4 for other devices)


---


**Power Specifications:**

Default TDP (Thermal Design Power): 65W

cTDP (Configurable TDP): 45W - 65W


---


**Thermal Specifications:**

Max Operating Temperature (Tjmax): 95°C


---


**Socket Compatibility:**

Socket Type: AM4

Compatible Chipsets: 300 series, 400 series, 500 series (A320, B350, B450, X370, X470, B550, X570, etc.)

Note: Check motherboard BIOS compatibility for 300 series chipsets


---


**Advanced Technologies:**

Precision Boost 2: Yes

Precision Boost Overdrive (PBO): Yes (with supported motherboard)

Extended Frequency Range (XFR): Yes

AMD SenseMI Technology: Yes

AES Instructions: Yes

AVX2 Instructions: Yes

Virtualization (AMD-V): Yes


---


**Security Features:**

AMD Memory Guard: No

Secure Memory Encryption: No

Secure Encrypted Virtualization: No


---


**Overclocking:**

Unlocked Multiplier: Yes (allows overclocking on B-series and X-series motherboards)

Max Overclock: Approximately 4.1-4.3 GHz depending on cooling 

---


**What's in the Box (Retail):**

AMD Ryzen 5 3400G processor

AMD Wraith Spire cooler

Installation guide


---


**Best For:**

Budget gaming PC without dedicated GPU

Home office and productivity

Media center / HTPC (4K video streaming)

Light photo editing

1080p gaming (with Vega 11 graphics) - able to run: Fortnite, CS:GO, League of Legends, Rocket League, older RPGs

Entry-level creative work


---


**Gaming Performance (Vega 11 integrated graphics):**

- 1080p Low/Medium settings: 30-60+ FPS in many esports titles

- 720p High settings: Smoother performance in demanding games

- Not suitable for AAA gaming at 1080p
